definitions.gloss: Super Chat; paid highlighted live-stream message
definitions.explanation: On YouTube live streams, a paid message from a viewer that is highlighted and pinned for a time; a way of tipping and supporting the streamer.

examples.japanese: スーパーチャットを{送|おく}る。
{配信中|はいしんちゅう}にスーパーチャットが{届|とど}く。
examples.english: A Super Chat arrives during the stream.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}の{配信者|はいしんしゃ}は、{視聴者|しちょうしゃ}からのスーパーチャットで{収入|しゅうにゅう}を{得|え}ている。
examples.english: Popular streamers earn income from viewers' Super Chats.

notes:
A YouTube Live feature: a paid, highlighted comment that supports the streamer. Commonly abbreviated スパチャ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スーパーチャットを{送|おく}る: to send a Super Chat
- スーパーチャットで{応援|おうえん}する: to support (a streamer) with a Super Chat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {投|な}げ{銭|せん}: tip; donation — the general idea of tipping an online performer
- スパチャ: the common abbreviation of スーパーチャット
